items.text: Service
We search and visit with you only what fits and, if needed, coordinate the renovation too.

items.label: Tell us what you are looking for

items.text: We search for you, visit with you, and hand you the keys.
You tell us what you need and we take care of the search: we find, filter and visit with you only what fits. Before you decide, we study the property in depth so you buy with no surprises.
And if the flat you like needs renovating, we coordinate that too, with the studio we work with.
This is an active search service you commission. If you would just like us to let you know when a suitable home comes up, you can [register your search](route:mySearch).
How we do it
From search to handover

items.title: Search profile
items.text: Area, type, budget and priorities: what you want and what you don't.

items.title: Active search
items.text: We scan the market against your criteria and, when there is any, stock that has not been published yet.

items.title: Selection
items.text: We only show you options that are worth a viewing.

items.title: Viewings
items.text: We organise them and accompany you with a technical eye.

items.title: Negotiation and purchase
items.text: We negotiate the price and accompany you to completion.

items.title: Renovation
items.text: If needed, we coordinate the project and the works with the studio we work with, so you can move straight in.
No surprises
What we review before you buy

items.title: The property
items.text: Real condition of the home, installations and any works with their cost.

items.title: The building
items.text: Condition of the building, technical inspection and planned works or community charges.

items.title: Documentation
items.text: Land Registry note, encumbrances, habitation certificate and energy certificate.

items.title: The price
items.text: Comparison with recent sales in the area so you don't overpay.

items.title: Financing
items.text: With the financial broker we work with, your mortgage is studied before you commit. [See financial advice](service:asesoramiento-financiero).

items.title: The surroundings
items.text: Services, transport, noise and neighbourhood evolution.
Renovations
Does the flat need renovating? We coordinate that too
Often the right property needs work. Instead of finding an architect, quotes and contractors on your own, we do it with the architecture and interior design studio we collaborate with.
Renovation quote before you buy, so you can decide with the full cost in hand.
Project, permits and works coordinated by us.
Timeline and finish monitoring until handover.
Let's talk
Every good decision starts with a conversation. Let's talk about yours.
